periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Helped 212 households enroll in food assistance and trained call-center staff to screen callers for food benefits. Posted a food help page in the resource directory. Partners: Harborview Housing Authority, Harbor Area Food Bank.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Open an enrollment desk at the Harbor Creek library and draft a mailed benefits guide.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Opened a weekly enrollment desk at the Harbor Creek library, and enrollments reached 287. Drafted a plain-language benefits guide for mailing. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Housing Authority, Harbor Area Food Bank.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Mail the benefits guide to 9,000 households and staff enrollment tables at two farmers markets.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Mailed a benefits guide to 9,000 households and placed enrollment staff at two farmers markets and the Harbor Creek library. The directory page for food help was the most visited section, and call-center staff saw more first-time callers. Partners: Harborview Housing Authority, Harbor Area Food Bank, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Translate the guide into Spanish and Haitian Creole, and embed a food screener at school registration.
